added.title: Director, Software Development
added.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

We are looking for a Director of Software Development to lead a key area of our Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform. In this role, you will build and lead a new engineering team in Austin while driving the delivery of a strategic initiative that helps Managed Service Providers (MSPs) monitor, automate, and optimize digital employee experiences across large customer environments.

You will be responsible for defining technical direction, building a high-performing team, and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to deliver scalable, reliable solutions that create measurable customer value.

As part of TeamViewer's AI-native engineering transformation, you will also help establish and evolve engineering practices that leverage AI-assisted development while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and reliability.

Responsibilities

Build, hire, and lead a new software engineering team in Austin, establishing a strong engineering culture and operating model.
Own the delivery of a strategic, multi-phase DEX initiative that serves MSP customers at scale.
Define and execute the technical roadmap for your area in alignment with the broader DEX platform strategy.
Drive the full software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and customer-focused.
Partner with engineering, product, and operational leaders to align priorities and execution across teams.
Establish engineering best practices, development standards, and quality processes that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining strong technical foundations.
Champion the effective adoption of AI-assisted development practices and help shape the organization's evolving AI engineering strategy.
Coach and develop engineering leaders and senior engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Proven experience leading and growing software engineering organizations, including building or scaling teams.
Track record of delivering large-scale SaaS or cloud-based platforms.
Strong technical background with experience in modern distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.
Experience introducing and scaling AI-assisted software development practices within engineering teams.
Ability to balance technical excellence, product priorities, and business outcomes.
Experience setting engineering standards, development practices, and quality expectations across teams.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, product, and business functions.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where team, product, and process are evolving simultaneously.

Preferred Experience

Experience with MSP, endpoint management, IT operations, or digital employee experience platforms.
Familiarity with technologies such as C#, Azure, Kubernetes, Kafka, Databricks, SQL Server, and related cloud-native tooling.
Experience leading teams that use AI coding agents, such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, in production delivery at scale
Working knowledge of model-based failure modes (hallucination, context degradation, prompt injection, non-determinism)

How We Work

We believe AI-assisted development will play an increasingly important role in how software is built and delivered. Engineering leaders at TeamViewer are expected to leverage modern AI development tools while ensuring strong engineering discipline, governance, testing, and quality standards remain at the center of the software delivery process.

You will help shape how these practices evolve across the organization while collaborating with peers to establish consistent and scalable approaches.

What we offer

Competitive compensation and bonuses
Flexible PTO and paid holidays
401(k) with employer matching
Comprehensive Health insurance package including 100% employer-paid medical coverage
Up to 12 weeks of Parental Leave
Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability, 100% employer-paid
Quarterly teambuilding events, leadership luncheons, and companywide “All Hands” meetings
Open door policy and business casual dress code
We celebrate diversity as one of our core values. Join c-a-r-e and lead change initiatives together with us!

Work location for this position is Austin, TX.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

added.title: Director of Engineering
added.description:
Director of Engineering - Product

Fully Remote - US

Base $210k - $240k + Competitive Equity

FutureTech Recruitment is partnered with a Series A EdTech startup backed by mission-aligned investors. The platform has strong commercial traction across multiple US states with strong NRR and a deeply mission-driven team with deep roots in the industry they serve. Series B on the horizon within 8-12 months.

They’re hiring a Director of Engineering - Product to report directly to the CTO and co-founder, taking ownership of multiple product squads. 50/50 hands-on IC and leadership to start, shifting to 80/20 over time. Real ownership of architecture decisions, squad delivery, and cross-functional alignment across a mission-driven team.

Responsibilities

Own multiple product squads - managing engineers and driving delivery across all of them
Hands-on early - contributing code, code reviews, and pairing (~50/50 IC to leadership, shifting to 80/20 over time)
Make and land key technical architecture decisions to ensure the platform scales for the next two years of growth
Partner with Product, Customer Success, and cross-functional stakeholders to align engineering priorities to business outcomes
Ship high-value product features on time, including advancing AI-powered capabilities

Requirements

2-3+ years managing multiple engineering teams (6+ engineers) - ideally including managing other managers
Hands-on technical ability - reads, reviews, and writes code; not a pure people manager
Strong backend architecture experience - able to ramp on new stacks (React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, MongoDB)
Experience owning major business verticals, products, and business outcomes (speed, quality, growth, retention)
Startup or high-growth environment experience - comfortable with ambiguity and independent prioritisation
Strong communicator - connects technical decisions to business outcomes and drives cross-functional alignment
Mission-driven - genuine passion for the education space
Able to travel for company retreats twice a year plus 2-4 additional business trips
No new visa sponsorship required - transfers considered

Tech Stack

React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, MongoDB

Series A, strong commercial traction, strong NRR, and Series B on the horizon within 8-12 months. Full benefits including health, parental leave, 401(k), unlimited PTO, and coworking access. If you’re a hands-on engineering leader who wants real ownership at a mission-driven startup with genuine product-market fit, we’d love to hear from you.

added.title: VP, Analytics Engineering
added.description:
BANC OF CALIFORNIA AND YOUR CAREER

Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE: BANC) is a bank holding company with over $34 billion in assets and the parent company of Banc of California. Banc of California is one of the nation’s premier relationship-based business banks, providing banking and treasury management services to small, middle market, and venture backed businesses. As the largest independent bank headquartered in California, the bank offers a broad range of loan and deposit products and services through a network of full-service branches and regional offices, as well as through digital and nationwide capabilities. The bank also provides full-service payment processing solutions to its clients and serves the Community Association Management industry nationwide through its technology forward platform, SmartStreet™. Banc of California is committed to supporting its local communities through the Banc of California Charitable Foundation and by partnering with organizations that promote financial literacy, job training, small business support, affordable housing, and more.

At Banc of California, our success is powered by our people and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful results. We foster an environment where entrepreneurial thinking is encouraged, and accountability and operational excellence are expected. Our team members are empowered to take ownership, make informed decisions, and make a meaningful impact as the bank continues to grow and evolve. We are dedicated to supporting your growth and wellbeing through comprehensive benefits, robust development opportunities, and inclusive programs that enable you to perform at your best. Together we win!

THE OPPORTUNITY

The VP, Analytics Engineering will lead the design and delivery of enterprise data products on the bank’s Data Foundation Platform. Reporting to the VP, Data Engineering & Delivery Manager, this hands-on, player-coach leadership role oversees a small team and works alongside engineers while partnering across the broader data organization and the business. This position combines deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake, dbt, and SQL with the ability to set standards, deliver quality data products, and develop talent in a SOX-controlled environment.

Performs all duties in accordance with the Company’s policies and procedures, all U.S. state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the Company operates.

How You’ll Make a Difference

Lead and work alongside a small team of Analytics Engineers, Data Architects, and Modelers; hire, coach, and develop talent.
Design, build, and deliver scalable data solutions hands-on using Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and Microsoft Azure.
Establish engineering standards for dbt, SQL, data modeling, documentation, version control, testing, and deployment.
Guide reusable dbt models, macros, and semantic models, and lead dimensional data modeling, including Star Schemas and Fact and Dimension tables.
Own the transformation and modeling layers of the platform.
Build quality into development through dbt tests, data contracts, documentation, and peer review, partnering with the Quality Engineering team, which owns enterprise test frameworks and release certification.
Champion agentic engineering across the team by applying AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate dbt model development, code generation, refactoring, and documentation, with governed human review.
Evaluate and adopt emerging agentic development patterns and tooling for the Analytics Engineering workflow, setting standards for the safe, auditable use of AI in a SOX-controlled environment, and partner with Quality Engineering, which owns the Agentic Test Harness.
Embed dbt tests and quality gates into Git-based CI/CD pipelines as part of standard development practice and support root-cause analysis of production data defects.
Optimize Snowflake performance and cost across query tuning, warehouse utilization, and transformation design.
Manage priorities, capacity, and delivery commitments, and partner with Product, BI, Governance, Operations & Quality, and the business.
Participate in interviewing and hiring decisions.
Prepare and deliver employee performance evaluations, goal planning, and counseling.
Manage, support, coach, and train employees.
Follow all established policies and procedures.
Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
8+ years of progressive experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Warehouse Development, or related roles.
3+ years of experience leading technical teams, managing engineering delivery, and developing employees.
4+ years of deep hands-on experience delivering enterprise data solutions using Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and Microsoft Azure.
3+ years of advanced experience with production-grade dbt projects, including modular models, macros, testing, documentation, lineage, freshness, snapshots, and incremental processing.
5+ years of experience in dimensional and relational modeling, data warehousing, Medallion Architecture, semantic models, and modern ELT.
Advanced SQL development, debugging, performance tuning, and query optimization skills.
Experience building well-tested, reliable data pipelines using dbt tests, data contracts, and data-quality checks as part of standard development practice.
Working knowledge of batch and CDC ingestion patterns using Azure Data Factory or equivalent technologies.
Experience with Python or another modern language for data processing, automation, APIs, and scripting.
Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
Experience with Git, Azure DevOps or comparable tools, CI/CD, pull requests, and automated quality gates.
Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, privacy, security, auditability, and regulatory controls.
Experience delivering data solutions in a SOX-controlled environment, including change management, control evidence, and audit support.
Ability to balance hands-on leadership, people management, delivery oversight, and strategic planning in a fast-paced environment.
Experience leading Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Data Architecture in a regulated organization.
Banking or financial services experience, including loans, deposits, treasury products, customers, accounts, or regulatory reporting.
Experience applying agentic AI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering delivery, including establishing standards for governed, auditable use of AI in development workflows.
Experience with data-quality or observability tools such as dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, or comparable platforms.
Relevant Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft Azure, or comparable cloud data certifications.
High school diploma or equivalent required.

How We’ll Support You

Financial Security: You will be eligible to participate in the company’s 401k plan which includes a company match and immediate vesting.
Health & Well-Being: We offer comprehensive insurance options including medical, dental, vision, AD&D, supplemental life, long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, and pre-tax Flexible Spending Account (FSA).
Building & Supporting Your Family: Banc of California partners with providers that offer adoption, surrogacy, and fertility assistance as well as paid parental leave and family support solutions including care options for your family.
Paid Time Away: Eligible team members receive paid vacation days, holidays, and volunteer time off.
Career Growth Opportunities: To support career growth of our team members, we offer tuition reimbursement, an annual mentorship program, leadership development resources, access to LinkedIn Learning, and more.

The base salary ultimately offered is determined through a review of education, industry experience, training, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant in alignment with market data and other factors.

Banc of California is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their actual or perceived race (including traits associated with race, such as hair texture, hair type or protective hairstyles), religion or religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), color, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, gender transitioning, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military or veteran status, medical condition, genetic information, or disability (mental or physical), requests for accommodation and any additional protected categories set forth in applicable federal, state or local laws. If you require reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact Talent Acquisition.
